newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabia press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia plans to link the electricity grids of four of the kingdom's regions in the framework of an ambitious project aimed at constructing a unified network.
- No agreement on India fares after airline Yield Improvement Committee meeting.
- U.S. firm, Phillips, announces intention to build a joint petrochemical complex with Saudi Aramco in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail.
- The income of the Saudi ports authority in the past 11 years totalled nine billion riyals.
